verdict.rationale: Clerk documents a first-party Next.js integration (clerk-docs-19), corroborated by a community comment calling the Next.js integration 'really quite good' (clerk-comm-14). Its CLI detects the framework and adds the needed auth files (clerk-docs-65). It also issues short-lived JWT session tokens for authenticating backend requests (clerk-docs-6, clerk-docs-22). However, the pack never documents middleware-based route protection, edge-runtime session verification, or SDKs for peer frameworks. Missing for 10: documented route-protecting middleware, edge session verification, peer-framework SDK coverage.
